title: Rock Band SCANDAL Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
content: The official website of SCANDAL announced on Monday that the four-member all-female rock band will disband on August 21, 2027, following their final concert at the Yokohama Arena in Kanagawa Prefecture. The disbandment date will coincide with the band's 21st anniversary.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Nekopara Sekai Connect Game Launches for PC on September 28
content: The game debuted on iOS and Android devices on April 14 in English and Japanese. The game commemorates the 10th anniversary of the franchise . Neko Works is credited for the production and editorial supervision, and Good Smile Company is credited for production and distribution.
author: ANN
